citations.assessment: The introduction to the chain comes at the end of 21b in the retrieved division, and the two teachings are at the beginning of 22a. Retain Heilprin’s original folio notation and link the passage itself.
The same chain transmits the exposition of the empty pit, with snakes and scorpions despite the absence of water.
The same chain transmits the Chanukah lamp height ruling, a parallel to the other teaching in Shabbat.

holds.reason: The three sources give Natan’s transmission from Tanḥum via Kahana. None of these loci bears directly on Rav’s studenthood. Preserve Heilprin’s failed lookup as his own limitation.
